title: Four toolbar directions for Excalidraw
summary: In testing, people couldn't tell some tools apart and missed the ones tucked away. We built four very different toolbars and picked one.

variations.name: Minimal and calm
variations.idea: Five tools up front, everything else one quiet click away.

variations.name: Playful and expressive
variations.idea: Big friendly icons with labels, and a little bounce when you pick one.
variations.why: Testers found every tool on the first try, and it still feels like Excalidraw.

variations.name: Dense for power users
variations.idea: Every tool and its shortcut in one compact rail.

variations.name: Big and touch friendly
variations.idea: Large targets along the bottom edge, easy to reach with a thumb.
